notes.title: Playtesting Update for August 2nd
notes.notes:
Eliminated several bugs based on playtester feedback, including but not limited to:

 Clouds not regenerating after disappearing.
 The cutscene that plays after returning to the Shrine resulting in a black screen upon ending.
 The Estate spirit behaving oddly when the Estate is entered from the Shrine.

notes.title: Last Pre-Release Update!
notes.notes: This is the final release of the Zenko: A Fox's Tale playtesting version! The team would like to extend a huge thank you to everyone who played Zenko over these past few months, and we welcome you to get the full game for free when it releases this week!

notes.title: Update for 7/7
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the spirit would spawn further ahead than intended when the level select was used.
 Fixed a bug where two Zenkos appeared when a cutscene was triggered.
 The Village is now accessible from the Shrine upon completion.

notes.title: Update for July 2nd
notes.notes:
The Estate has several new areas to explore.
 There have been several updates to the Shrine and Village to make them more feature complete.


Interested in playtesting with our dev team? Join the community Discord server at https://discord.gg/XUwuEgZfbD and sign up for a playtesting slot! Our final day for the current session is July 5th, so join soon!

notes.title: Update for Version 0.3.0
notes.notes: This update features some improvements to the visual effects of the Shrine and a few modifications to the Village and Estate!

notes.title: First open Steam Playtest version!
notes.notes: Version is identical to the one used in the closed playtest, but with the play session metrics set to remote saving only.
